content: The World Health Organization (WHO) has published a guideline for the non-surgical management of chronic primary low back pain in adults, specifically designed for use in primary and community care settings. This document, titled Web Annex B: Protocols for Evidence Syntheses, is part of the broader WHO guideline on this topic and is available electronically under the ISBN 978-92-4-008568-8.
